definitions.explanation: Shoes specifically worn outdoors, in contrast to {内履|うちば}き (indoor shoes). Common in schools, hospitals, and other places where indoor and outdoor footwear are separated.

examples.japanese: {外履|そとば}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}いで→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take off your outdoor shoes here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外履|そとば}き⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{内履|うちば}き→内履き：30221_uchibaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けている→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: At school, outdoor and indoor shoes are kept separate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{外履|そとば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いた→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
examples.english: Before entering the hospital I put my outdoor shoes in a bag and carried them with me.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (outside) + ⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (to wear on the feet). The institutional practice of switching shoes is widespread in Japan: schools, gyms, hospitals, and some workplaces require ⟦{内履|うちば}き→内履き：30221_uchibaki⟧ indoors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外履|そとば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: to take off outdoor shoes
- {外履|そとば}き⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for outdoor use
- {外履|そとば}き{入|い}れ: bag/locker for outdoor shoes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内履|うちば}き→内履き：30221_uchibaki⟧: indoor shoes (antonym)
- ⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧: indoor school shoes — specifically the soft shoes worn at school
- ⟦{下駄箱|げたばこ}→下駄箱：06490_getabako⟧: shoe cupboard at an entryway
